ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure, $AB$ is the diameter of $\odot O$, points C and D lie on $\odot O$, $\angle BCD=15^\circ$, what is the degree measure of $\angle AOD$?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since $\angle BOD=2\angle BCD$ and $\angle BCD=15^\circ$, \\
it follows that $\angle BOD=30^\circ$, \\
thus $\angle AOD=180^\circ-\angle BOD=150^\circ$, \\
therefore, $\angle AOD=\boxed{150^\circ}$.
